It is not a verified NAV oracle, immutable dollar value, current reserve solvency, executable redemption or independent financial assurance. Existing mint, upgrade, blocklist and reserve obligations remain unchanged.

localReviews.rationale: The current Saturn FAQ dated October 12, 2026 distinguishes the Ethereum holder USDat-to-USDC M0 order route from approved-wallet USDat-to-PYUSDx Swap and from the separate sUSDat NFT withdrawal queue. The USDC route permits screened eligible wallets without Saturn direct-mint approval, can fill partially and has no guaranteed completion maximum. Published quote-cost caps exclude gas and conflict with the older mint/redeem page, so this review retains the more conservative 10 bps interface ceiling descriptively, not an all-in bound. This establishes restricted published withdrawal terms with high risk; it grants no solver funding, measured capacity, settled USD value, direct PYUSD ownership or bridge exit.
